title: Raise conditional κ to 0.00312192127 with retained native copies
body:
Thirteen paid native conversions retain current source values for later scalar contacts on exact [PR5751](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5751). The new word changes seventeen helper targets and removes thirteen other transports. Conditional κ rises from **0.00311301600 to 0.00312192127**, a gain of **0.00000890527 (0.2860657%)**.

The paid-call and target counts stay fixed. The signed delta is `8H4 + 16H5 + 6H7 - 12H1 - H6 - 17H8`. An exact majorization certificate proves its gain for every power exponent `0<t<1`. The complete rational calculation encloses the raw crossing in `(0.00312192130450, 0.00312192130451)`.

The package is `research/p104-retained-native-copy`. It provides a fixed constructor and plan, a literal word, source-version and ownership witnesses, a complete proof, rejection controls and an authenticated predecessor export. It uses 767 arbitrary public inputs, 22 owned labels, 24 owned lifetimes and peak 12 live owned fields. All 13 new COPY/query/use/CLEAR paths are charged. The complete caller retains 66,834 paid jobs, 13,390 targets and rank surplus 760.

Validation: primary, registered normal and optimized replays pass; all 789 input columns, 2,925 native maps/phases, the complete caller, two rational interval engines, compiler, 54 strict outer predicates and four functional checks pass. Nine word/caller/invoice controls and the native phase control are rejected. Metadata/pins, committed bytes, source ancestry and export integrity pass. A separate read-only, Git-free `-I -O -B` replay with empty PATH passed in 104.635 seconds; every file byte and mode remained unchanged. The full-history preflight was not run in this shallow checkout; both declared top-level source ancestries were checked directly.

Replay: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-retained-native-copy` (standard library, two registered modes, 600 seconds per mode).

The five inherited framework assumptions remain. No large uniform word or rounded multiplier is materialized. Independent acceptance remains pending; the selected frontier is unchanged. Hosted [planning CI failed](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40373038100/job/121748561453) before scientific replay. The replay job was skipped. Its eight failures and two errors in `test_research_current_assignment.py` reproduce locally. The test, both picker scripts and the task catalogue are byte-identical to main; the tests still expect the old command mappings after revision8. No hosted scientific pass is claimed.

Source: PR5751 at `8483f9a679d06c1e270141dbc686a7e76e7a7522`, preserved in this branch's authenticated archive. The branch starts from canonical main `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`, priorities revision 8. [Discussion5645](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5645#discussioncomment-19200517) records the separate retained-copy scope. The R22 block composition is not included.

Credit Ali Romman's PR5751 and P104 work, flyingviper [PR5718](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5718), Joel Pulikkan / GamingPuzzled [PR5739](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5739) for the dimension-four basis, Cinna Davis's controller, and all native/compiler/BIT contributors retained in NOTICE. New construction, search, verification and proof: Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. No subagents. Apache-2.0.
